g.text: Common FIM-off stage-end anchor: star. Colored line: projected saved trajectory. Gray arrows: projected continuous dynamics on the frozen slice.
Contours freeze observations and unresolved modes at the same FIM-off stage-end anchor for each paired method. FIM changes feedback, while the H functional stays fixed.
Trajectories are full-field projections, so their other modes can move off the slice. Phase axes are shared within each query column; H levels and arrow scales are local.
Energy jumps at new observations are preserved. The gradient control has p = 0 and displays a potential slice. No SF or global pose is introduced.
